
LIST-WORK-UNITS
Query the board: filter work units by status, type, prefix, epic, ids, time ranges, stateHistory, text, content and links, then pick fields, sort, limit, group and format the result

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command for every question about the board: which cards are in a status, what was done or created in a time range, which cards entered a status, which have open questions or assumptions, what blocks what. Use show-work-unit to read one card in full.

USAGE
  fspec list-work-units [options]

OPTIONS
  -s, --status <status>
    Statuses (comma list): backlog, specifying, testing, implementing, validating, done, blocked
  -t, --type <type>
    Types (comma list): story, task, bug
  --prefix <prefix>
    Prefixes registered in spec/prefixes.json (comma list)
  -e, --epic <epic>
    Epics registered in spec/epics.json (comma list)
  --work-unit <workUnitId>
    Cards by id, or inclusive ranges of one prefix (comma list), e.g. BUG-600..BUG-620
  -p, --parent <workUnitId>
    Cards whose parent is this card
  --has-children
    Cards with child cards
  --estimate-min <n>
    Estimate at least n (a card without an estimate never matches)
  --estimate-max <n>
    Estimate at most n
  --has-estimate
    Cards with an estimate
  --no-estimate
    Cards without an estimate
  --created-since <time>
    Created at or after <time>
  --created-until <time>
    Created before <time> (a date covers that whole local day)
  --updated-since <time>
    Updated at or after <time>
  --updated-until <time>
    Updated before <time>
  --done-since <time>
    Done cards whose last transition into done is at or after <time>
  --done-until <time>
    Done cards whose last transition into done is before <time>
  --entered <status>
    Cards with a stateHistory transition into <status>
  --entered-since <time>
    With --entered: a transition at or after <time>
  --entered-until <time>
    With --entered: a transition before <time>
  --text <text>
    Case-insensitive substring of the title or description
  --title <text>
    Case-insensitive substring of the title
  --has-open-questions
    Cards with a question that is neither answered nor deleted
  --has-assumptions
    Cards with assumptions (provisional decisions)
  --has-rules
    Cards with rules (deleted items do not count)
  --no-rules
    Cards without rules
  --has-examples
    Cards with examples
  --has-attachments
    Cards with attachments
  --has-architecture-notes
    Cards with architecture notes
  --tag <@tag>
    Cards with a feature file whose Feature line holds the card's @ID and whose Feature line or any scenario carries <@tag>
  --depends-on <workUnitId>
    Cards whose dependsOn holds the card (comma list); any: dependsOn is not empty
  --blocked-by <workUnitId>
    Cards whose blockedBy holds the card (comma list); any: not empty
  --blocks <workUnitId>
    Cards whose blocks holds the card (comma list); any: not empty
  --relates-to <workUnitId>
    Cards whose relatesTo holds the card (comma list); any: not empty
  --blocked
    Status blocked, or blocked by a card that is not done
  --fields <fields>
    Output fields (comma list): id, title, type, status, epic, prefix, description, estimate, parent, children, createdAt, updatedAt, doneAt, enteredAt:<status>, ageInStatus, openQuestions, assumptions, rules, examples, architectureNotes, attachments, dependsOn, blocks, blockedBy, relatesTo, dependencies (default id,type,status,epic,title)
  --format <format>
    table (default), ids, json, jsonl, count or csv
  --group-by <key>
    status, type, prefix, epic, day or week: counts per group (json: the groups with their cards); day and week use the local time of the query's one time filter
  --sort <field>
    Sort by an output field (times chronologically, absent values last)
  --desc
    Reverse the --sort order
  --limit <n>
    Keep the first n cards after sorting

TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  backlog → specifying → testing → implementing → validating → done. Use --status to see each stage, --done-since or --entered for what moved recently.

EXAMPLES
  1. Count the cards done in the last 2 days per local day
  $ fspec list-work-units --status done --done-since 2d --group-by day
  DAY         COUNT
2026-11-06  4
2026-11-07  2

6 work units

  2. Cards in testing or specifying with open questions
  $ fspec list-work-units --status testing,specifying --has-open-questions

  3. Bugs created since 30 October (local time) that are not done
  $ fspec list-work-units --type bug --created-since 2026-10-30 --status backlog,specifying,testing,implementing,validating,blocked

  4. Ids of the cards blocked by BUG-123
  $ fspec list-work-units --blocked-by BUG-123 --format ids
  BUG-124
BUG-130

  5. Cards with assumptions (provisional decisions)
  $ fspec list-work-units --has-assumptions --fields id,title,assumptions

  6. One card's open questions and assumptions
  $ fspec list-work-units --work-unit AUTH-001 --fields id,openQuestions,assumptions --format json

  7. Cards that entered validating since local midnight of 7 November
  $ fspec list-work-units --entered validating --entered-since 2026-11-07 --format ids

  8. Cards done in the last week, counted per type
  $ fspec list-work-units --done-since 1w --group-by type --format count
  bug 5
story 3

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Unknown status 'donee'. Valid statuses: backlog, specifying, testing, implementing, validating, done, blocked
    Fix: Use one of the listed values; types, prefixes, epics, fields, formats, group-by values and sort keys are checked the same way

  ✗ Invalid time 'yesterday' for --created-since
    Fix: Use YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO-8601 timestamp, a duration back from now (30m, 6h, 2d, 1w) or now

  ✗ --group-by day needs exactly one kind of time filter (created, updated, done or entered)
    Fix: Add one time filter, e.g. --done-since 2d, so the day of that time is the group key

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec board
  fspec create-story
  fspec create-bug
  fspec create-task
  fspec update-work-unit-status

NOTES
  • Filters are exact (no fuzzy matching): a comma list or a repeated flag matches any of its values, and different filters must all match.
  • A time is a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the start of that day in the local time zone), an ISO-8601 timestamp (local unless it carries Z or an offset), a duration back from now (Nm, Nh, Nd = N x 24 h, Nw) or now. Since is inclusive, until is exclusive.
  • Times print in the local time zone with its offset; a field the card does not have is left out of its JSON object and empty in table and csv.
  • Never read or parse spec/work-units.json directly (no jq, grep or scripts): query it with list-work-units and read one card with show-work-unit.
